<section class="imp-block imp-about" id="about">
  <div class="imp-wrap">
    <div class="imp-about-grid imp-reveal">
      <div>
        <h2>About Saiful</h2>
        <p>Saiful Islam is a Salesforce System Architect and the technical lead at TwinStack Solutions, a Salesforce consultancy and AppExchange PDO based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Over more than a decade in the Salesforce ecosystem, he has guided projects from feasibility and architecture through development, security review and AppExchange listing.</p>
        <p>His focus is the full ISV lifecycle: validating ideas against Salesforce governor limits, designing data models that scale from ten to ten thousand users, and shipping native applications built on Lightning Web Components and Apex. He leads a team of 35 people serving clients across North America, Europe and Australia.</p>
        <p>He founded Twinforce Solutions in August 2022 and has been Managing Director of Twinforce Solutions Limited, the parent company of TwinStack, since January 2024.</p>
        <h3 class="imp-xp-h">Experience</h3><ol class="imp-xp"><li><b>Managing Director</b><span>Twinforce Solutions Limited &middot; Jan 2024 to present &middot; Dhaka, Bangladesh</span></li><li><b>Founder, Proprietor and Salesforce Architect</b><span>Twinforce Solutions (sole proprietorship, now Twinforce Solutions Limited) &middot; Aug 2022 to Dec 2023 &middot; Dhaka, Bangladesh</span></li></ol><div class="imp-quote">&ldquo;We don&rsquo;t just write code; we navigate the entire ISV lifecycle. Let&rsquo;s get your product listed and generating revenue.&rdquo;</div>
      </div>
